h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Raichur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Raichur

items.pText: In Raichur, between the Krishna and the Tungabhadra, children play outdoors mostly in the early morning and after about five in the evening. For most of the year the midday sun is too fierce. That makes the direction a playground faces almost as important as what is on it, because the low evening sun from the west can make some pieces uncomfortable.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 590 km from Raichur, and sends it to north Karnataka by road. Our installation team or a dealer in the region installs it at schools, colonies, power-plant townships and public gardens. Send us your site plan or photos with the north direction marked, the age group and the size. We will plan the orientation and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Facing equipment away from the evening sun

c: Children sliding down a slide that faces west look straight into the evening sun, and the surface has been heating all afternoon. Where possible, point slide exits north or east. A
keeps the sliding surface covered whichever way it faces.

Use buildings and trees on the western side of the site as natural shade, and put the play area in their shadow for the evening hours. Swings can run north to south so children are not swinging into the sun. A pergola from our
can cover seating where there is no natural shade.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 590 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Which way should a slide face in Raichur?
items.a: North or east where possible, so children are not facing the evening sun and the surface stays cooler. A tunnel slide is another option on open ground.

items.q: Can you plan the layout from our site plan?
items.a: Yes. Mark the north direction and any buildings or trees, and we will place each piece with its safe play area on the layout drawing.

items.q: Do you supply Raichur and nearby towns?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Raichur and towns such as Bellary and Gulbarga, and our team or a dealer installs the equipment.
